- precondition:
  - OBSERVATION contains "You arrive at <receptacle_id>." (use this to extract <receptacle_id>).

- MUST output: {"patch_ops":[{"op":"set","path":"return.target_object_location","value":"bowl 1 at countertop 3"}]}
- If X (<receptacle_id>) is in memory.unsearched_receptacle_ids, you SHOULD include list_remove in the SAME response:
  {"patch_ops":[{"op":"set","path":"return.target_object_location","value":"bowl 1 at countertop 3"},{"op":"list_remove","path":"memory.unsearched_receptacle_ids","value":"countertop 3"}]}
- CRITICAL: If OBSERVATION contains any "<target_object> <n>", you MUST output set_location and MUST NOT output only list_remove.

delete_frontier_on_arrive:
- precondition:
  - Let X be the id extracted from OBSERVATION string "You arrive at X.".
  - OBSERVATION does NOT contain any "<target_object> <n>".
  - OBSERVATION contains "On the X, you see" OR "In the X, you see". (means you inspected it)
  - OBSERVATION does NOT contain "X is closed".
- function: remove X from memory.unsearched_receptacle_ids.
- MUST output: {"patch_ops":[{"op":"list_remove","path":"memory.unsearched_receptacle_ids","value":"desk 2"}]}

delete_frontier_on_open:
- precondition:
  - LAST_ACTION starts with "open ".
  - OBSERVATION starts with "You open the ".
  - OBSERVATION does NOT contain any "<target_object> <n>".
- how to get X:
  - Prefer parsing X from LAST_ACTION "open X".
  - If that fails, parse X from OBSERVATION "You open the X.".
- function: remove X from memory.unsearched_receptacle_ids.
- MUST output: {"patch_ops":[{"op":"list_remove","path":"memory.unsearched_receptacle_ids","value":"cabinet 2"}]}

[SELECTION POLICY]
- Evaluate set_location FIRST. If its precondition holds, you MUST output set_location (and include list_remove if applicable).
- Else evaluate delete_frontier_on_open. If its precondition holds, you MUST output delete_frontier_on_open.
- Else evaluate delete_frontier_on_arrive. If its precondition holds, you MUST output delete_frontier_on_arrive.
- Only if none holds, output {"patch_ops":[]}.
